slides.text: The legendary blade Aethelgard was said to be the ultimate weapon. It had a unique enchantment: it could slice through absolutely anything, but only if the wielder held absolute, righteous conviction in their heart. In the hands of a true hero, it could cleave a boulder in twain. In the hands of a doubting coward, it would bounce off a simple apple. When the Dark Lord invaded, our desperate King pulled the pristine sword from its sacred vault.

The King marched to the front lines, roaring speeches of justice and divine right. He swung Aethelgard at the first heavily armored orc that charged him. The sword shattered into a dozen pieces against the monster's iron shield. The King's heart had been full of greed and political ambition, not righteousness. The army panicked. The Dark Lord laughed, stepping over the weeping King to claim his victory. That’s when the young camp cook picked up the broken hilt.

Only a jagged, two-inch shard of metal remained attached to the handle. The boy didn't care about kings, politics, or holy wars. He only cared about protecting his little sister, who was hiding in the supply wagons. He held the broken hilt with terrifying, absolute certainty. As the Dark Lord swung his massive warhammer, the cook thrust the tiny shard forward. With a blinding flash of golden light, the broken blade sliced the dark god entirely in half.
